survey: A stylized saguaro cactus on a desert sand card. Main parts: (1) a tall ribbed trunk standing upright, its base sunk into the sand with a small depression and a contact shadow, so it is planted, not floating; (2) a left arm that leaves the trunk's left side low down, bends up at a rounded elbow and ends in a domed tip; (3) a right arm that leaves the trunk's right side higher up, wraps slightly toward the camera, bends up and ends in a domed tip; (4) a pink flower on a small green receptacle on the trunk's crown; (5) short cone-shaped spines in rows along the ribs of the trunk and both arms. The trunk faces the camera with a slight three-quarter turn. Both arms join the trunk in solid unions, and the ribbing runs continuously along the trunk and each arm. The arms are at different heights, which is natural for a saguaro.
